title: Domain Mapping
definition: The process of organizing and categorizing concepts within a language model according to their domain of origin.

difficulty_levels.beginner: The act of sorting and classifying the knowledge in a language model based on its subject matter or domain.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The process of strategically categorizing concepts within a language model according to their domain of origin to improve its reasoning abilities.
difficulty_levels.expert: The art of organizing and categorizing concepts within a language model according to their domain of origin, aimed at enhancing its performance and versatility within those domains.

extra_fields.insight: The strategic categorization of concepts within a language model based on their domain of origin to improve its reasoning abilities.
